intro: I'm a creative full-stack developer, currently studying for a Master's in Web Engineering at ESGI.
After two years of work-study at AGREEGO, where I designed and built showcase websites and contributed to a SaaS platform, I'm looking to join a team for a new two-year work-study position.
What drives me: building polished, fast and accessible interfaces, from the Figma mockup all the way to production.
Front end, back end or DevOps: I want to grow alongside experienced developers and bring my rigour and curiosity to your projects.

intralab.title: IntraLab
intralab.description: School intranet built during my third year at ESGI: moderated blog, equipment loans, student marketplace and encrypted real-time messaging. A full-stack Nuxt 4, Prisma and PostgreSQL application with 46 API routes secured by JWT and roles.
intralab.tagline: A school intranet, from the database to real-time messaging.
context: IntraLab is the intranet of an ESGI-style school: students, administrators and academic managers publish articles, borrow equipment, sell to each other and chat.

The project was carried out by a multidisciplinary team in our third year at ESGI. I owned the entire web side, from the interface to the server, while other students worked on cybersecurity and system and network infrastructure.

missions.title: Interface
missions.description: A dark interface with frosted-glass surfaces over an animated WebGL background (OGL), built with Tailwind CSS and reusable components, on desktop and mobile.

missions.title: API & database
missions.description: 46 REST API routes with Nuxt 4 (Nitro), 16 Prisma models on PostgreSQL and Zod validation of every input.

missions.title: Real-time & security
missions.description: WebSocket messaging (replies, reactions, typing indicator, read receipts), messages encrypted at rest (AES), JWT authentication, bcrypt-hashed passwords and role-based access control on every route.

missions.title: Production
missions.description: Deployment on a Debian virtual machine: PM2 for the Node process, Apache as a reverse proxy (WebSocket included) and Prisma migrations.

features.title: Moderated blog
features.description: Articles go through a draft, pending, published or rejected workflow, validated by administrators and academic managers.

features.title: Loans & marketplace
features.description: Borrowing school equipment with approval and return tracking, and student-to-student sales with search, filters and sorting.

features.title: Messaging & notifications
features.description: Real-time conversations and notifications for every event: loan request, approved article, new message.

extra: The project brought several ESGI specialisations together: I led web development, my classmates handled cybersecurity and system and network infrastructure.
I also documented the application, with a technical sheet and a step-by-step deployment guide for a Linux virtual machine.

agreego.title: AGREEGO
agreego.description: Showcase website for AGREEGO, an agricultural drone company based in Reims: seeding, biocontrol treatments and AI-powered crop diagnostics. Designed in Figma and built from scratch with Nuxt 4 and Tailwind, bilingual FR/EN, optimised for search and tracked with Google Analytics.
agreego.tagline: The showcase website of a drone fleet working for farmers.
context: AGREEGO is a company from Reims that puts a fleet of drones and their pilots at the service of farmers: cover-crop seeding, biocontrol treatments (trichogramma release, targeted spraying) and AI-powered crop diagnostics.

During my work-study programme I owned the website end to end: it had to present technical services to a farming audience, build trust with farms, cooperatives and distributors, and turn visits into appointment requests.

missions.title: Design
missions.description: Figma mockups, from the site map to desktop and mobile screens: a sober, image-led identity built to be read quickly in the field.

missions.title: Development
missions.description: Built from scratch with Nuxt 4 and Tailwind CSS. Minimal scroll animations with AOS, navigation and an appointment form qualified by service.

missions.title: SEO
missions.description: Per-page title and description tags, structured data (Organization, FAQPage, SoftwareApplication), per-language sitemaps and a full English version with Nuxt i18n.

missions.title: Analytics & deployment
missions.description: Audience tracking with Google Analytics and continuous deployment on Vercel.

features.title: Solution pages
features.description: A dedicated page for each service (seeding, treatments, diagnostics) with benefits, process and FAQs.

features.title: Appointment booking
features.description: A contact form on every page, qualified by the requested service.

features.title: Bilingual FR / EN
features.description: Translated content and localised URLs to reach customers beyond France.

extra: Alongside the showcase websites, I contributed extensively to AGREEGO Cloud, the company's SaaS platform for managing drone campaigns.

It brings administrators, pilots, agronomists and end customers together in a single tool: field editing and selection, real-time creation and tracking of drone rounds, GPS guidance, flight plan generation, SMS and email notifications, online reports and statistics.

viteego.title: VITEEGO
viteego.description: Showcase website for VITEEGO, the viticulture subsidiary of the AGREEGO group: vine inventory, centimetre-accurate surveying and NDVI vigour maps by drone and AI. A vineyard-specific identity, designed in Figma and built from scratch with Nuxt 4, Tailwind and AOS.
viteego.tagline: The AGREEGO group's viticulture subsidiary, mapped by drone and AI.
context: VITEEGO is the viticulture subsidiary of the AGREEGO group. It offers winegrowers three drone services: inventory of missing or unproductive vines, plot surveying accurate to ± 0.3 cm and leaf vigour analysis (NDVI) at 25 mm resolution.
The challenge was to give the subsidiary its own identity, distinct from AGREEGO and rooted in the world of wine, while explaining cutting-edge technology simply to winegrowers.

missions.title: Design
missions.description: Identity and mockups in Figma: a burgundy palette drawn from wine, mapping visuals in the spotlight and a clear hierarchy between the three solutions.

missions.title: Development
missions.description: Built from scratch with Nuxt 4 and Tailwind CSS, scroll animations with AOS, solutions, approach, about and contact pages.

missions.title: SEO
missions.description: Per-page tags, structured data (Organization, Service, OfferCatalog, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList), per-language sitemaps and an English version with Nuxt i18n.

missions.title: Analytics & deployment
missions.description: Audience tracking with Google Analytics and continuous deployment on Vercel.

features.title: Three detailed solutions
features.description: Inventory, surveying and NDVI analysis presented with their benefits and visuals from actual flights.

features.title: FAQ
features.description: Answers to winegrowers' questions (accuracy, flight periods, machine compatibility) that also feed Google rich results.

features.title: Bilingual FR / EN
features.description: Translated content for an international wine-growing audience.

about.title: About
about.intro: Creative full-stack developer based in Reims, I design and build web experiences where aesthetics, interaction and performance carry equal weight.
bio: I'm Ethan Rieu, the person behind ERIEU. I build from the first Figma frame to the deployed product, so that the design intent survives all the way to the browser.

My playground is the modern Vue ecosystem: Nuxt for structure and performance, GSAP and Three.js for motion and depth, Tailwind for a consistent visual system, Node and PostgreSQL when a project needs a real back end.

I train myself continuously on the latest technologies, not to chase trends but to pick the right tool for each project and its constraints. Today, I'm looking for a work-study position to keep growing within a team.

values.title: Design first
values.description: Every project starts in Figma. Typography, rhythm and motion are decided before the first line of code, then respected pixel for pixel.

values.title: Motion with meaning

values.title: Built to last

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: This website collects the bare minimum: what you write to me through the contact form and anonymous visit statistics. No ads, no third-party trackers, no data sold.

sections.title: Data controller
body: Ethan Rieu, publisher of this website. For any question about your data:

sections.title: Contact form
body: Data collected: name, e-mail address, message, and the language of the site you used.
Purpose: replying to you. Your data is used for nothing else: no marketing, no newsletter, never sold.
Legal basis: legitimate interest in replying to people who contact me (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR).
Retention: 3 years from our last exchange, then deleted.

sections.title: Recipients and processors
body: Your messages are only read by me. Two technical providers are involved in delivering them:
Resend (sends the e-mail to my inbox) and Vercel (hosts the website), both based in the United States.
These transfers outside the European Union are covered by the safeguards provided by the GDPR (EU–US Data Privacy Framework or the European Commission standard contractual clauses).

sections.title: Security and spam protection
body: To prevent abuse, your IP address is kept in memory for one hour at most to cap sending at 5 messages per hour. It is never stored or linked to your message.
Like any host, Vercel keeps technical logs (including IP addresses) for a limited time to keep the service secure and running.

sections.title: Analytics
body: This website uses Vercel Web Analytics, without cookies. Only aggregated data is measured: pages viewed, referring site, country, device type, browser and operating system.
Visitors are not identified: the fingerprint used to count visits is anonymised and reset every day. This measurement therefore does not require your consent.

sections.title: Cookies
body: A single cookie is set: i18n_redirected. It remembers the language of the site (English or French) when you land on the home page, for 12 months.
As it is required for the interface to work, it is exempt from consent. No advertising, social media or tracking cookies are used. You can delete it at any time from your browser settings.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You have the right to access, rectify, erase, object to, restrict and port your data. To exercise these rights, write to me: I reply within one month at most.
If you believe your rights are not respected, you can lodge a complaint with the CNIL, the French data protection authority.
